headline: Chile’s Bci to Lend US$200 Million to Startups in 2027
summary: Banco de Credito e Inversiones announced plans to lend $200 million to startups in 2027, representing a 33% increase over 2026 lending volumes.
why: Venture debt expansion by major private banks supports early-stage technology startup ecosystems and enterprise growth financing.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Increased venture lending availability supports local startup expansion and capital formation.
